name: Wild Magic Sorcery

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Raw chaos magic that surges unpredictably, bending luck your way, or not.

feature.name: Wild Magic Surge
feature.summary: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, roll a d20; on a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.
feature.text: Once per turn, right after you cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot, you can roll a d20. On a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random magical effect. If that effect is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic.

feature.name: Tides of Chaos
feature.summary: Give yourself Advantage on one D20 Test; it comes back after a Long Rest or a Wild Magic Surge.
feature.text: You can manipulate chaos itself to give yourself Advantage on one D20 Test before you roll the d20. Once you do, you must cast a Sorcerer spell with a spell slot or finish a Long Rest before you can use it again. If you cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot before your next Long Rest, you automatically roll on the Wild Magic Surge table and regain this use.

feature.name: Bend Luck
feature.summary: Reaction: spend 1 Sorcery Point to add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's d20 roll.
feature.text: Immediately after another creature you can see rolls the d20 for a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction and spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll 1d4 and apply the number as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the d20 roll.

feature.name: Controlled Chaos
feature.summary: Roll twice on the Wild Magic Surge table and use either result.

feature.name: Tamed Surge
feature.summary: Once per Long Rest, right after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, create any effect from the Wild Magic Surge table.
